design: Four candidate behaviors motivated by H998 natural residuals: clause completion, list markers, noun expectation, within-word fragments.8source pairs x2wordings. Native competence plus all18 last-token MLP captures; no featurizer fitting.
split: A first4 discovery,last4 lexical; B first4 structural,last4 joint. These are development source slots; action vocabulary shared in noun probes. No native outcome-dependent replacements.
gate: At least4distinct token-valid pairs, >=.75both-endpoint category correctness and >=.5intended full-vocabulary top1; report all failures/exclusions.
groups: Fixed candidate token categories per family; continuation boundary checked independently for each endpoint; no overlapping categories. Word fragments use literal no-space BPE suffixes.
limits: Matched current tokens checked, not assumed. List_marker quarantined diagnostic because related to original sequence_copy holdout. Other candidates require causal tests and confound controls before adding labels. No new-task discovery claim from competence alone.
